channel.title: Newshound
channel.description: The day’s news, found by following where expectations shifted.

item.title: Saudi Arabia says East-West oil pipeline was attacked near Medina
item.description: An attack on the pipeline in the Medina region on Monday started a limited fire, but Saudi officials said oil flows were not affected.

item.title: Gemini 4 Carbon billing listings and access appear on Google Cloud before any announcement
item.description: Billing entries for Google's Gemini 4 Carbon, priced for general customers, appeared in Google Cloud's public catalog on November 10, and some developers say the model already answers on Vertex AI, though Google has announced no wider release.

item.title: Fed's Waller backs December rate hike and says a half-point move should be considered
item.description: Fed Governor Christopher Waller said he would support at least a quarter-point hike at the Dec. 8-9 meeting, and October consumer prices then came in firmer than expected.

item.title: Anthropic sets IPO price range of $70 to $78 and launches roadshow
item.description: An amended SEC filing on Tuesday lays out an 825 million share Nasdaq offering under the ticker ANT, with trading expected to start around November 19, according to people familiar with the plans.

item.title: Trump says he will stand by Hegseth as Massie forces House impeachment vote
item.description: Rep. Thomas Massie filed eight impeachment articles against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth on Monday, and Trump said he would keep him even if the House impeaches him.

item.title: Trump calls Iran war "effectively over" but keeps naval blockade in place
item.description: After meeting Qatar's prime minister on Monday, Trump said the US would hold to the "status quo" with Iran, keeping the naval blockade and ruling out new strikes for now, while a US official said a breakthrough in talks was unlikely.

item.title: OpenAI starts selling Codex edition of ModRetro Chromatic handheld
item.description: On November 8 OpenAI posted a one-word "Tomorrow" teaser, and on November 9 it turned out to be the public sale of a retro game handheld, not a new model.

item.title: Judo champion Teddy Riner announces run for French president in 2027
item.description: The five-time Olympic gold medalist declared his candidacy on Monday as an independent, "neither right nor left," and must now gather 500 sponsorships from elected officials.

item.title: Trump says renewed war with Iran is "highly unlikely" if talks make progress
item.description: In a CNN interview on Sunday, Trump said he probably won't need to order new attacks on Iran if negotiations go well, but warned US forces are ready to destroy dozens of Iranian bridges.

item.title: Jeffries says he will vote to impeach Hegseth as House vote nears
item.description: House Democratic leader Hakeem Jeffries said Sunday he is a "hard yes" on impeaching Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, and Rep. Thomas Massie said he could force a floor vote as early as Monday.

item.title: Trump says Dana White press secretary offer was a joke
item.description: A day after posting that he had offered the UFC chief the job, Trump told reporters on Sunday he was "only kidding," so the White House press secretary post is still empty.

item.title: Anthropic pushes ahead with pre-Thanksgiving IPO at a lower valuation target
item.description: Reports say Anthropic will start its investor roadshow this week and aims to raise $80 billion to $100 billion at a $1.25 trillion to $1.75 trillion valuation, down from earlier talk of $2 trillion.

item.title: Trump meets Qatar's mediator as Iran offers to restart talks if blockade lifted
item.description: Trump said over the weekend that he saw no reason to escalate the war with Iran, and Qatar's prime minister was due at the White House Monday as Tehran defended a two-day plan to restart negotiations.

item.title: Petition against Jeffries as speaker passes 1 million signatures, but no rival emerges
item.description: A Change.org petition urging House Democrats to pick someone other than Hakeem Jeffries for speaker passed one million signatures on Saturday, while no Democrat has stepped forward to challenge him.

item.title: Anthropic presses ahead with pre-Thanksgiving IPO as roadshow week begins
item.description: After reports that Anthropic will accept a lower valuation rather than delay, the Claude maker heads into its investor roadshow aiming to list on Nasdaq before November 26.

item.title: Trump says he was "only kidding" about offering Dana White the press secretary job
item.description: A day after posting that he had offered the job to the UFC chief, Trump told reporters on Sunday it was a joke, leaving the White House press secretary post still vacant.

item.title: Rubio says Iran talks have made no progress and calls Tehran's demands "outrageous"
item.description: On Sunday Rubio said there was no breakthrough in sight in the Qatar-mediated talks with Iran, while Trump said new strikes were "highly unlikely" if the talks show progress.

item.title: Jeffries backs Hegseth impeachment as House Republicans brace for defections
item.description: House Democratic leader Hakeem Jeffries said Sunday he is a "hard yes" on impeaching Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, and Axios reported GOP leaders expect enough Republican defections for the measure to pass this week.

item.title: Final New Zealand poll puts Labour ahead, with Opportunity holding the balance
item.description: The last The Post/Freshwater Strategy poll before Saturday's vote has Labour 4.3 points ahead of National, but neither bloc has a clear path to a majority without the Opportunity Party.

item.title: Rubio says he will serve out Trump's term and stop talking about 2028
item.description: After a Bloomberg report that he was weighing leaving the administration, Secretary of State Marco Rubio told the New York Times that staying with Trump to the end of the term has always been his plan.

item.title: Iran says more tankers hit mines in Hormuz as talks on reopening the strait stall
item.description: Iranian forces said at least five tankers and a tugboat caught fire on November 5 after using routes Tehran has banned, a day after Iran called the latest US reply to its Hormuz conditions unconvincing.

item.title: Anthropic IPO meets valuation pushback as AI stocks slide after midterms
item.description: A broad selloff in tech and AI shares on Thursday left investors resisting Anthropic's hoped-for valuation of about $1.5 trillion, and the company is set to review its listing plans in the coming days.

item.title: Alito tells friends he won't retire now despite Democrats winning the Senate
item.description: Reports late Wednesday said Justice Samuel Alito will not step down during the lame-duck session, and people close to Clarence Thomas said the same about him, making a Trump appointment before January unlikely.

item.title: Strong October jobs report revives case for a December Fed rate hike
item.description: US employers added 165,000 jobs in October and unemployment fell to 4.1%, and several Fed officials argued for more tightening, a day after a post-election tech selloff had weakened the case for a hike.

item.title: Tabloid report says Josh O'Connor told castmates he will be the next James Bond
item.description: The Sun reported on November 5 that a co-star from O'Connor's West End play Golden Boy said in a pub that he had landed the role of 007. Amazon MGM has not confirmed it.

item.title: Van Hollen will not challenge Schumer for Senate majority leader, source says
item.description: The progressive favorite to replace Chuck Schumer is staying out of the leadership race, but is pressing the caucus to agree on an agenda before it votes.

item.title: Jeffries formally launches bid for House speaker after Democrats win majority
item.description: A day after Democrats won the House, Hakeem Jeffries sent colleagues a letter asking for their support as speaker, and no serious rival has emerged.

item.title: Nigerian court voids Atiku's ADC presidential ticket and sacks party leadership
item.description: A Federal High Court in Abuja nullified Atiku Abubakar's nomination as the ADC candidate for January's election, removing a main opposition rival to Peter Obi; the ADC says it will appeal.

item.title: Arab parties back Eisenkot, giving him a majority of recommendations for prime minister
item.description: With 67 of 120, he's expected to get the first chance to form Israel's next government.
